interpretations: Use the average modulation index of all signals as the overall average. Keep joined telescope and weather groups whose average modulation index exceeds it. For each weather profile, average the retained group averages equally for modulation index and phase shift, and report the average absolute excess in modulation index.

Use the average modulation index of all signals as the overall average. Keep qualifying joined telescope and weather groups, then calculate each weather profile’s modulation index, phase shift, and average absolute excess across the signals in those groups, weighting larger groups more heavily.

Use only signals that successfully join to a telescope and observatory to calculate the overall average modulation index. Keep groups above it. For each weather profile, average the retained group averages equally and report their average absolute excess.

Use only successfully joined signals to calculate the overall average modulation index. Keep groups above it. For each weather profile, calculate the final averages and absolute excess across signals in retained groups.

queries:
WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
),
telescope_groups AS (
    SELECT
        t.telescregistry,
        o.weathprofile,
        AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
        AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
    HAVING AVG(s.modindex) > (SELECT avg_modindex FROM overall)
)
SELECT
    weathprofile,
    AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg,
    AVG(ABS(avg_modindex - (SELECT avg_modindex FROM overall))) AS avg_absolute_excess
FROM telescope_groups
GROUP BY weathprofile

WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
),
qualifying_groups AS (
    SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
    CROSS JOIN overall
    GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile
    HAVING AVG(s.modindex) > overall.avg_modindex
)
SELECT
    q.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modulation_index,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift,
    AVG(ABS(s.modindex - overall.avg_modindex)) AS avg_absolute_excess
FROM qualifying_groups AS q
JOIN signals AS s ON s.telescref = q.telescref
JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
   AND o.weathprofile IS q.weathprofile
CROSS JOIN overall
GROUP BY q.weathprofile

WITH joined_signals AS (
    SELECT s.modindex, t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM joined_signals
),
telescope_groups AS (
    SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS group_avg
    FROM joined_signals
    GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile
)
SELECT g.weathprofile,
       AVG(g.group_avg) AS avg_group_modindex,
       AVG(ABS(g.group_avg - o.avg_modindex)) AS avg_absolute_excess
FROM telescope_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE g.group_avg > o.avg_modindex
GROUP BY g.weathprofile

WITH joined_signals AS (
    SELECT o.weathprofile, s.modindex
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM joined_signals
)
SELECT
    j.weathprofile,
    AVG(j.modindex) AS avg_modulation_index,
    ABS(AVG(j.modindex) - overall.avg_modindex) AS absolute_excess
FROM joined_signals AS j
CROSS JOIN overall
GROUP BY j.weathprofile
HAVING AVG(j.modindex) > overall.avg_modindex

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.weathprofile,
       AVG(ABS(g.avg_modindex - a.avg_modindex)) AS avg_absolute_excess
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
WHERE g.avg_modindex > a.avg_modindex
GROUP BY g.weathprofile

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.telescregistry,
        o.weathprofile,
        AVG(s.modindex) AS group_avg
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
    g.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modulation_index,
    SUM(ABS(s.modindex - a.overall_avg)) AS absolute_excess
FROM group_averages AS g
JOIN signals AS s ON s.telescref = g.telescregistry
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
WHERE g.group_avg > a.overall_avg
GROUP BY g.weathprofile
